purpose: Mechanism links for hard-gap over-acquisition. Same-program overlap, request-only access and model-vs-measurement boundaries remain explicit; no automatic promotion is performed.

entries.evidence: PASCOE trial publishes per-cycle CSVs plus stage and label files, providing explicit cycle-level raw process records.
Second PASCOE trial day provides an additional open-access distribution set from the same line.
C-P-T fusion is experimentally validated across multiple injection-moulding machines and materials.
16 cavities, 34 pressure sensors, five experiments and physical weight measurements directly demonstrate filling imbalance and cavity-to-cavity process behaviour.
16-cavity/30-sensor experiment links holding-phase changes, cavity-pressure signatures and part mass; institutional/tool overlap with MM-DATA-136 requires conservative independence counting.
Two-cavity hot-runner thin-wall experiment links nozzle pressure and tie-bar strain to adaptive process settings and measured weight stability.
Independent industrial two-cavity hot-runner experiment controls cavity-pressure trajectories with iterative learning control.
Servo-electric valve-pin opening stroke is used as a manipulated variable for cascade-injection cavity-pressure control.
Online nozzle/tie-bar indexes drive staged process corrections and are evaluated against part-weight and appearance outcomes.
Five ABS grades/vendors are intentionally changed while cycle-mass feedback adjusts holding pressure; mass/dimensions are physically measured across 16 cavities.
Real sensor measurements correct a spatiotemporal injection-mould cooling model and validate temperature-state prediction at ejection.
High-volume core-insert service-life study tracks process/thermal/failure variables and makes raw supporting data available on request.
Ejector-pin-hole wear volume and surface morphology are measured at repeated 100,000-cycle intervals.
Micro-Fresnel mould insert wear is measured every 1,000-2,000 cycles through a 24,500-cycle production campaign.
Coated and uncoated relay moulds are run to flash-based failure thresholds at roughly 32k-134k cycles, providing a physical quality-linked wear endpoint.
Rapid-tooling insert develops ejector-region flash then loses extraction function under continued cycling.
2026 experiment validates cross-machine quality prediction using multisensor features and physical weight/dimensional classes.
UHMWPE/HDPE two-component fabric-insert moulding provides an additional material/interface process family with author-requestable data.
Hot-runner moulded virgin and recycled PP are compared through crystallisation and mechanical outcomes.
Industrial mould inserts processing 30 wt% GF-PP are tracked through 90,000 cycles for coating/tool wear.
PM tool-steel hardness loss after roughly 200 injection cycles is linked to measured thermal loading during abrasive polymer flow.
Independent coated/uncoated mould-steel samples process glass-fibre PP through 45,000 cycles with wear resistance quantified.
